{
  "dataset_name": "blood_transfusion",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "donation_frequency_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of total donations (V2) to months since first donation (V1), capturing donation rate over time",
      "value_range": [0.043, 21.0],
      "feature_family": "donation_behavior",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures donation intensity normalized by donor tenure; frequent recent donors more likely to donate again",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V2 / V1"
    },
    {
      "name": "recency_bucket",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal bucket of recency (V1): 1=very recent (1-3), 2=recent (4-8), 3=moderate (9-15), 4=distant (16+)",
      "value_range": [1, 4],
      "feature_family": "recency",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Tree-splittable ordinal encoding of recency; very recent donors have higher return probability",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V1 <= 3, 1, np.where(V1 <= 8, 2, np.where(V1 <= 15, 3, 4)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_very_recent_donor",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator: 1 if months since last donation (V1) is 2 or less, indicating very recent activity",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "recency",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Strong binary split signal; very recent donors are most likely to donate again",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V1 <= 2, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "blood_volume_per_donation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average blood volume donated per visit (V3 / V2), should be ~250cc per donation",
      "value_range": [250.0, 250.0],
      "feature_family": "donation_consistency",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Validates data consistency; deviations may indicate data quality issues or special donation types",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V3 / V2"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_total_volume",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed total blood volume donated (V3) to reduce skewness",
      "value_range": [5.52, 8.57],
      "feature_family": "donation_volume",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces right skew in V3; tree splits on log scale capture diminishing returns of high-volume donors",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(V3)"
    },
    {
      "name": "tenure_to_recency_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of months since first donation (V4) to months since last donation (V1); high values indicate long-term but recently lapsed donors",
      "value_range": [0.02, 98.0],
      "feature_family": "donor_loyalty",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures donor loyalty vs recency tradeoff; long-tenure recent donors are most valuable",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V4 / V1"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_frequency_donor",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean: 1 if total donations (V2) >= 10, indicating a highly engaged repeat donor",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "donation_behavior",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Direct threshold split on donation count; high-frequency donors have established donation habits",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V2 >= 10, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "donation_gap_months",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average months between donations: (V4 - V1) / (V2 - 1), clipped to avoid division by zero edge cases",
      "value_range": [0.0, 96.0],
      "feature_family": "donation_regularity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures donation regularity; shorter gaps indicate habitual donors more likely to return",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V2 > 1, (V4 - V1) / np.maximum(V2 - 1, 1), V4)"
    },
    {
      "name": "recency_frequency_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of inverse recency and frequency: (1/V1) * V2, combining low recency with high frequency",
      "value_range": [0.048, 21.0],
      "feature_family": "rfm_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Nonlinear RFM interaction; high values indicate frequent recent donors, strongest return signal",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(1.0 / V1) * V2"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_lapsed_donor",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean: 1 if recency (V1) > 12 months AND frequency (V2) < 5, indicating a lapsed infrequent donor",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "donor_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Identifies at-risk donors unlikely to return; strong negative signal for donation probability",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((V1 > 12) & (V2 < 5), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "donor_engagement_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Holistic engagement score (1-5) based on combined assessment of recency, frequency, and tenure patterns. Score 5: very recent + high frequency + long tenure. Score 1: distant + low frequency + short tenure.",
      "value_range": [1, 5],
      "feature_family": "rfm_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Composite ordinal feature capturing overall donor engagement profile; provides clean splits for tree models",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "sqrt_frequency_times_volume",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Square root of the product of donation frequency (V2) and total volume (V3), capturing combined donation impact",
      "value_range": [15.81, 331.66],
      "feature_family": "donation_volume",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Nonlinear combination of frequency and volume; captures high-impact donors with both many and large donations",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(V2 * V3)"
    }
  ]
}
